scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Welcome, come in~
Oh, I see that you take
much better care of your
hair than those other boys.
Now would you like to dye
your hair another color?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
欢迎光临，请进~
哎呀，看来你很注重头发护理呢，
比那些男孩子强多了。
那么，你想换个发色吗？

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Oh, wow~ Where did
you get your hair styled?
I love it! But... It would
be even more beautiful if
you dyed your hair. What
do you think about that?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
哇~ 你的发型是在哪里做的？
我很喜欢！不过... 如果染个发色会更漂亮哦。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Dye Hair
scripts.translation: 染发

scripts.text: Coloring Information
scripts.translation: 染发资讯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Ho ho ho ho~
So which color would
you like to try? Something
vivid or dark? Sexy or cute?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
Ho ho ho ho~
想试什么颜色？鲜艳还是深沉？性感还是可爱？

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Ooh, I like this color!
But would you like to
try a different one?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
哦，这个颜色不错！
不过，你想换个别的颜色试试吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Please select
another color~
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
请再选一个颜色~

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
An excellent choice~
Alright then, thank you
for using my service and
I hope you come by again!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
很棒的选择~
那么，感谢使用我的服务，
期待你下次再来哦！

scripts.text: Red, please.
scripts.translation: 染红色

scripts.text: Yellow, please.
scripts.translation: 染黄色

scripts.text: Purple, please.
scripts.translation: 染紫色

scripts.text: Orange, please.
scripts.translation: 染橙色

scripts.text: Green, please.
scripts.translation: 染绿色

scripts.text: Blue, please.
scripts.translation: 染蓝色

scripts.text: White, please.
scripts.translation: 染白色

scripts.text: Dark Brown, please.
scripts.translation: 染深棕色

scripts.text: I like my hair color.
scripts.translation: 保持现在的发色

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Are you sure?
Alright then, you
know what's best for
your beauty and to tell
the truth, I agree with you~
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
你确定吗？
好吧，毕竟你最了解自己的美。
说实话，我也很赞同你的看法~

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Oh, I see. Still, I can't
help but feel so disappointed.
You'd look so good if you dyed
your hair a different color~
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
这样啊，还是有点失望呢。
换个发色，你一定会很好看~

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Hmm, your hair color
is still fine, so there's
no need to dye it the same
color again, if that's what
you're worried about.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
你现在的发色还很好，不用担心，也没必要重复染同一种颜色。

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Oh, I'm sorry dear,
but I can't dye your
hair if you didn't bring
Scarlet Dyestuffs with you...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
不好意思，亲爱的，没带红色染料，我就没办法帮你染发...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
Oh, I'm so sorry dear,
but my service fee is
1,000 zeny. Did you forget
to bring your money with you?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
真是不好意思，亲爱的，
我的服务费是1,000 Zeny。
难道你忘记带钱了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
When you're feeling
down, when you just want
to look nice for the one you
love, or when you just want
a different look, why don't
you dye your hair?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
心情低落，想为心爱的人打扮一下，或只是想换个造型时，不妨试试染发。

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
All you need is one
Dyestuffs item of the
color that you want to
dye your hair, as well as
a 1,000 zeny service fee.
I'm here for your beauty needs~
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
准备一份你想要的颜色的染料，再付1,000 Zeny服务费，就可以了。
你的美丽，就交给我吧~

scripts.text:
[Rossa]
You know, when you
put some effort into
your appearance, you'll
not only look better, but
you'll feel better about
yourself. Makes sense, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎]
用心打理外表，不仅看起来更漂亮，自己也会更开心。
对吧？
